messages.author: 90ad96479c2b5cce
messages.subject: Change grey background color
parts:
Dear list,

I am new to ggplot and I am having trouble to change the grey background color of the ggplot2 default plot. I run a Spatial Eigenvector Mapping GLM to understand what environmental variables influence whales distribution in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
I have the following code that I used to plot:

ggplot(bryde3, aes(x = SLOPE, y = c1$neo.pred,)) + 
   stat_smooth(method = "glm", family = "binomial", se = TRUE) +
   labs( x = "Slope(m)",
        y = "Occurrence of whales")

# bryde 3 is my dataset
# SLOPE is one of my environmental variables
# c1$neo.pred <- predict(glmerr12, type = "response", se.fit = FALSE)
#glmerr12 is my GLM model

The resulting plot has a grey background and white lines.
Can anyone help me?

Thanks in advance,
Rodrigo


--
Rodrigo Tardin

Doutorando em Ecologia e Conservação - IBRAG - UERJ
Mestre em Biologia Animal - PPGBA - UFRRJ
Especialista em Docência do Ensino Superior - IAVM
Laboratório de Bioacústica e Ecologia de Cetáceos - UFRRJ/ IF/ DCA
